messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The GO requests the measurements to the MSP. The MSP checks the received request. The MSP denies the request of the GO or the MSP performs the measurement. The MSP informs the GO about the failure of the reading or the MSP transmits the measured values to the GO. The GO processes the measured values. The GO sends the changed values to the MSP. The GO transmit the readings to the SP.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GO_RequestMeasurements" name="Request Measurements from MSP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_GO_ResponseWaiting" name="Wait for Response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_ToDenial</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_ToFailure</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_ToValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GO_DenialReceived" name="Request Denied Received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_ToDenial</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_DenialEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEvtDef_GO_Denial" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GO_Denied" name="Process Ended (Denied)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_DenialEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GO_FailureReceived" name="Reading Failure Received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_ToFailure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_FailureEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEvtDef_GO_Failure" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GO_Failed" name="Process Ended (Failed Reading)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_FailureEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_ToSendChanged</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_ToTransmitSP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_SuccessEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
